objectives.text: Rewrite a lambda as each kind of method reference: static (Integer::parseInt), bound instance (System.out::println), unbound instance (String::length) and constructor (ArrayList::new)
Decide when a method reference is clearer than the equivalent lambda, and recognize a lambda that cannot become one
